text: An enjoyable game to begin with, but would be a lot better if two things were different. 1: the higher you go the bigger hike in coins levels demand, often you can only make maybe 1 attempt level every few hours which slows progress massively. 2: After a streak of a few levels the game seems to be designed to deliberately make you fail. 5,6,7 card flips in a row without a single match? Come on guys! Sometimes you can go through several cards before you're even able to make the first move!

Pop up hell. loved this little game to begin with. Found it very relaxing and fun to play. once I got up to the high 30's levels the pop ups advertising for extra packs became so intrusive I have had to stop playing. I now get 4 to 5 packs advertised, one after the other, every time I click on a play button. This ruins the flow and ruins the game. I installed the game as part of my Netflix games account, but it seems it is still a shameless way to pester for money. Very annoying.

This used to be a fun game to play,but it has been made harder and harder to finish a level. I don't know if the company is under the impression that players will avail themselves of the various offers that pop up, offering extra coins to finish the level, I certainly don't. If the game keeps throwing in pop-ups of offers, and becomes more difficult, I will simply uninstall it.

It costs to much to play each solitaire game with the credits and it's set up to make you fail so that you keep buying more app credit, just so you can keep on playing. I enjoy the game but I don't enjoy being ripped off. I wouldn't believe the first feed back that you see on here. Click on all feed back and you'll see what people really think of the scamming way these developers try to rinse you of your money. If you enjoy paying to play then this game is for you. If you don't, then stay away

Very disappointed. I’ve played this game for 5+ years. I bought coins (£1.29 last week and £5+ today) and both times items/packs didn’t come through due to what seems like a glitch. After repurchasing, I received the first one, proving an issue exists. Today my refund was refused and, worse, my game access was removed after reporting a missing purchase. I paid for items not received and got penalised for raising it. Really unfair and upsetting.

Too many pop-up/push ads. I could handle the constant harassment to make in game purchases when they were present (albeit sometimes five times over) just upon opening the game. Now they pop up after every level played, win or lose, making it seem like a cheap trick to cool people into clicking on purchase without realising it. If this doesn't change soon, I'm deleting this game. It's a shame, too, as I had been really enjoying it til now.

I like the game itself. I like the recipe, dice and puzzle sections, but the dice game now has fewer rewards. The videos and spider's lair detract from the game. The videos drone on while the player is held hostage. The spiders lair goes through a long restart every time a round is lost. Three consecutive ads is too many. I don't like that the next round opens automatically before you get a chance to look at your rewards. There are places when a card turns over and the screen changes too fast.

Levels are really badly made, you can have a perfect run and then you cycle through about 10 cards that you can't do anything with. The levels are based entirely on the chance of what cards you get and that is obviously to make it really rare to be able to successfully pass a level without spending in game currency which is pretty scarce without real money.

it was a really great game. Now money grabbing takes at least 3hrs to get enough money to play 1 go. Deliberately blocks you from winning rounds especially if the balloon basket turns up as it's an instant lose. If yr near the wheel or nxts level up it will deliberately what I call have waste cards that will make you not win. I'm at nrly 40grand a go and it rises at the end of every level. I'm in charge of my own group of players that I can't interact with. I never win anything anymore.

its a really fun game, I liked it because it didnt have ads but now they've started throw in some optional ones, which is fine. I really dont like how little money you get from things though. every hour you can get enough coin to play one level. the extra goodies you can get for winning a level has become increasingly pitiful. used to be pretty decent winnings. the only way you can play the higher multiplier levels, is if you spend money because you'll never earn enough to get the amount needed

Have been playing this game for years and love it. However recently the number of adverts has increased and now spoils the fun. Also the way the cards turn over to be played from the pile is staged so you cannot finish the game. For instance when you don't need an 8 (say) you get a lot but then when you need an 8 you get none. This not random and spoils the game. Thinking of giving up on this game after many years

I've been playing this game for a long time and enjoy it. But you have to accept it's all about trying to make you spend money. There are an increasing number of in-purchase pop-ups, and lots of silly activities where you can win prizes, but the value of those prizes is forever being reduced, so that you need to play round the clock (or spend money) to have a chance at completing them. The game is also clearly manipulated, regularly leaving a single card and the temptation to buy more coins...

I've played this game for a long time and it is such a good way to pass time/wind down. Unfortunately, you do need to pay more and more money to progress. There is obviously an algorythm that will drain your coins and make you spend more money when you're doing well. I've noticed that seemingly impossible levels suddenly become possible after a monetary purchase. There are so many solitaire apps out there that offer much better incentives. Don't get hooked on this one.

The game is a scam. It's designed to force you to spend coins to finish a game. You can easily spend 10-20k coins in a single game, which would cost £1-2 to get. Or you can wait 15 hours (assuming you collect your coins every hour). Any one who thinks spending that amount of money/time on a single game of solitaire is justified are part of the problem. Save yourself the stress and get a normal app for solitaire.

Far too much money spent just to get enough credits to play a few games. The "harvest now" button is every hour, you get just over 2 thousand credits and but then in order to play the x4 (3bars) in a level, it costs over 10 thousand credits.. So then you have to buy them with real money, they're then used up quickly because you're charged for the extras too if you want.. Gutted because the game itself is amazing but I feel you're taking too much money.

I'm so sick of the entry page not loading! Fix it!! The game is designed for you to spend your own money if you ever want to win the higher prizes, you're constantly bombarded with advertising to buy coins because to get anywhere it costs money. For instance £5000 coins to start a game, £11000 to buy extra cards. Game win is £3,500 so you have to collect loads of coins or buy them before you can actually play. It sucks!

Great game. However very quickly the price of a game far outstrips rewards. I'm on level ~150, levels are 2500 and I only get 5000 a day, 2500 per harvest. I get about 3 levels a day now. Also, boosters are far too expensive. 7500 for a wildcard and it's still increasing. I understand motivating for purchases but I feel it's so much more expensive than other games.

Used to absolutely love this game,as I am not a social media person, had to start from beginning every time when I changed a handset and did not mind it, reached a level of at least 1000 every time. However lately Game has more glitches than I can count, it's super slow, keeps kicking me out and lags on every thing I try to do. Please fix it. At this stage it feels like I am playing something connected to dial-up Internet.

Would give more stars if the developers would actually read these reviews and fix the issues. Pop-ups...where do I start? The amount is insane. I was enjoying this game until I kept getting stuck on levels and having to replay them over and over. yeah, use the extra 5 cards...then you're out of gold. The crops could easily be cut down (level wise). Face it, if you really want to play this game get ready to spend alot of money, time and aggrevation! Games are supposed to be fun not stessful!!

I love this game and have been playing it for 5yrs BUT recently, which has become aggravating, the amount of pop ups to buy things is too much. Also, you start a build or a pet or a mini game and BOOM gone! Can't you just keep something and let us finish it? I know the pet is so many days but there is absolutely no way, unless you spend a good fortune, you can get to the end of stage 5. The constant changes like that and the pop ups every start of the game and new level is frustrating.

I'm giving this game 2 stars only because it does have potential to be a great game, but it's clearly set up to part players from their money. Unless, I made purchases while playing this game (which I'd always blow right through), I found it to be just a losing proposition (I like a bit of a challenge, but come on!). And unless I made purchases, I was only able to play, maybe, 1 or 2 games at a time, which would result in losses a good majority of the time. That's not what I call, enjoyable.

I have to say that I enjoy the game but I urge everyone that plays this game not to spend money!! I've gone down the route of trying to contact them after money spent! Plus once you start spending £3 here and there it always gets more expensive and turns into more! I've noticed since I've spent money within this app that the prizes in the external game are unattainable! Please whatever you do ...do not spend money on this game!

Honestly it's a money grab game. As you advance in the game, it costs more to play, but the rewards you win don't increase. But hey, most games are pay to play so I still enjoy it for what it is. Edit: Yea I enjoyed it for what it was but they got too greedy, changed the stakes. Now I'm gonna use up all my coins and uninstall. It's definitely a high risk extremely low reward game.

I like this game. The thing I want most for it is a storage for all the set decorations. I Hate that they disappear as soon as you replace them! and in order to complete the next set you are forced to replace them! PLEASE make a storage so we can keep the items we EARNED AND ENJOY. then we can choose for ourselves what we want to display, and still get to earn the sets without losing our favorites! also please make the forever pets easier to acquire! still haven't earned even 1.

Update to game: I'm not sure what's going on, but for the last couple of months, the game has become very laggy and takes forever to start up and is running very slow,but not sure if it's all the updates it keeps getting,I've never known a game to get so many updates and I'm certainly not seeing much difference in the game when they keep doing it 🙄

This is a great game. This type of solitaire is my favorite to play. It can cost a lot of coins to play each level. But all you need to do is just not play for a few hours or days and just harvest coin fields. My only issue is that sometimes it takes 1 or 2 card flips at the start of a level to get a card you can actually play onto. Which seems a bit unfair when you have a limited number. Just this morning I had to flip 6 cards before I could even start playing. But it's usually 1 or 2.

I play this game all the time. There seems to be a commonality in the reviews. If you have alot of coins, say 1m+ you are on a roll and winning. As soon as you lose, you lose one round 10x over. Then all the pop ups start with the game conning you into spending more money so you will have a better chance at winning with "more rewards". This game has become very frustrating! It needs fixed. Stop making all the extra rewards so expensive and internal reward games hard to win.

Edit: initially rated 1 ⭐ but as I got farther, it got easier. Some advice to the developers; don't make the first 90 levels so difficult, or at least give more gold to start. I almost quit, was losing more than I won. Now it's at least 1/3rd of the time I get the right cards to win. Also, why does it cost $2k to play a level and you only get like $2,045 if you win? Doesn't seem fair to me. At a further level there are events that allow us the earn money faster, should be from the start.

Expect to spend a LOT of money. I am not opposed to in game purchases but this one just burns through your gold no matter how much you buy. And the extra time with the boosters are a sham. First they are only 5-15 minutes but then all of the ads and restarting of each level and any thing that is ancillary to the game play is counted against that time. So 15 is really only 7 or 8 minutes. Just not enough upside for the money spent. Shame because it is fun.

it's fun, but the rewards you get are nothing compared to the resources you have to spend in the game. if you beat a block or lvl, you don't get nearly enough to re coop the coins you spend on a " free" card. its basically another pay big money to stay ahead or wait about. 5 hours if harvesting time ( 60 minutes ) between harvest. So it could be funner if it was more balanced.

I have played this game for a few years, and it was great. Helped fill the boredom. However, the most recent update is terrible. It keeps getting stuck loading. Loading what, I have no idea. But when you get a booster for 5 minutes and the screen is loading for at least half that time, it's hard to enjoy the game anymore. That, and something changed a few months ago making it very difficult to gain money. I'm not going to spend real world money on a game that is supposed to help relax me.

game is super fun, but has REALLY gotten to point they want you to buy things. I am over level 1700 and it's sad now game won't let you win a level. they want you to spend money on coins. I can have over 500,000 coins and spend all trying to win one level-at lowest cost. so, unless you are spending money, which I don't, you have to wait to collect enough to even play.

I've been playing for years, but the recent changes are unacceptable. Once you reach high levels, the game turns into an aggressive monetization trap. They slashed the Daily Free Gift to just 10k–20k coins, while a single basic level attempt now costs a staggering 98K coins! They completely removed the cheaper boost options and hiked up the remaining prices. The system uses artificial difficulty barriers too to induce frustration buying. Not a single cent more from me!

Money grabber I don't know who giving this a 5 star maybe it someone who willing to spend money left and right. It set up to have you spend money to get to the next game. It could be a fun game if your not stuck on the same hand ALL THE TIME. Well of course you can move to the next game if you buy buy buy. Good news though the pop up to purchase is always popping up. Who needs ads.

It's an OK solitaire game. It does seem to be a bit of a money grab. I've had multiple levels where I'm on the last card with 5 or more unused cards in my hand that are unused. This would make sense in real life using a single deck, but this is supposed to be somewhat of a strategy game. 5 card draw is also a gamble as you aren't guaranteed at least having 1 usable card match in the 5 cards.

Starting to get frustrated with the game. Past several days, have not been able to collect my daily gifts. Click on the Facebook page to get my gift? It sends me to my Google Play account for no reason. It's never done that, always gone right to the game itself. Customer support was good enough to give me Friday & Saturday's gifts, but the suggestions they gave yield no results in correcting the issue. So, once again...another day with no free gift.

Popups for purchases are way out of control. Just when you want to click on something you have to close sometimes 7 in a row. And repeats very often.Very aggravating. And bonus timers should stop while your closing them. It's not fair that the bonus 5 or 10 minute timers are still running while we have to close all these popups.

As others have said, it's a flagrant money grab game that looks like a solitaire game but has the mechanics of a slot machine, and a fixed one at that. Each hand costs you about 1,800 gold, the undo button costs 300 gold, and if you need a few more cards to try to clear, that costs you 3,000 gold. Run out of gold? That costs you real money. Way too stressful and aggravating.

Been playing for a week trying to earn some cash thru Top Survey app. I've realized that you have to pay to keep playing. The game is fun and a little relaxing but the downside is that it takes way too long between each crop grow and it costs too much to choose extra cards or the wild card to help finish the round. Already have paid around $20 to keep playing, and that's about my limit. Its too bad because I really like that that there are NO ADS at all, and there are no glitches either.

Prior to yesterday's update, this would have been 5 stars. I have been enjoying this game for months (and making micro purchases to enhance my enjoyment). However, the latest change making the "golden windmill" tool available only at the highest levels is turning this into even more of a pay to play game. The solitaire play is fine, but it's the boosters that really make this game fun, and the change to the game's best booster makes it too expensive in in-game currency to access.

I really like the game, but when I try to use the free extra cards by watching an ad, it can be frustrating...the game is interrupted and sometimes shut down and I have to open it from the start. No free anything is given! Sometimes it works, but some of these ads have no clear indication of how to quit them and there's no way to get back to the game except to restart it...with no reward!

This is a Tripeaks style solitaire game. The thing to remember about this is, at least 10% of deals are impossible to beat before you start, and many more are impossible if you don't randomly guess the correct card. This is important to note because you get very few daily attempts, which becomes infuriating. I implore you: NEVER spend a penny on this game. You will often be confronted with situations where no amount of skill will overcome a situation that requires money. Do not fall for it.

I used to love playing this game but as the prizes get lamer the prices get higher on any purchase, also super frustrating that you can't play off line anymore as it takes you to some beginners level and tells you to download your stupid level which you obviously can't do off line. I used to play it on my tablet in my car on my lunch break. now I'm back to candy crush.

The game is enjoyable until you advance far and everything costs way more to play, but your rewards do not go up proportionally to the cost of coin it costs per round, so your stash will diminish very quickly. This is a VERY greedy game. Once they know you'll pay, the algorithm will make sure you lose so that you have to keep paying to play.

game doesn't follow logic because often more than four cards of any type in the deck. game makes no sense other than to pick consecutive cards either increasing or decreasing value. at level 145 there a six aces in the deck (dealer is cheating). In some games a stupid frog sits on a card preventing it being played. Now, there's a bomb in a card, if played blows up the game and you lose.

obvious money grab. fun at first, but you won't advance without spending a lot of money. > spend 2k on a level, you only get like 2.25k for a win. Congrats! you won 250 coins, don't spend it all in one place! > can take up to 10 tries to beat one level > need to spend coins on power ups to even the odds > pop up ads all the time. save yourself time and money & download Disney solitaire instead. it's much more fun & fair compared to this rigged knock off. not getting a dime from me.

Now I love playing this game but it definitely has flaws .. My only issue with this game is how are you gonna have me spend like 11,000 coins just to win one board??? it's ridiculous! you already want (if you're playing level 1) over 2,000 coins for the regular board! like c'mon man y'all are clearly robbing people oan not too mention every coin package starts at $5-7 dollars minimum and they show you this after EVERY BOARD smh This the type of game you play for a while and then let it go.

if your playing for money through an app it's a waste level 44-46 depletes coins including the ones paid for to get through the levels. spend your money if you really enjoy playing I don't enjoy any game that much to be spending anything. there's plenty of other games where you can get through the first hundred and not deplete the free stuff that you have gotten. The amount of coins to start the levels just keep going up therefore making it almost impossible to get past level 50

so far so Great it really is a fun game... honesty I quit this game because it's geared to make you buy in or lose. at least five times I would run out of coins and because of the increase in pmt of each game it's impossible to stay ahead. it's literally a game of chance that doesn't give you a chance without money. I liked it but am on a budget and can't buy in.

AVOID THIS GAME! There is no skill or strategy to this game even if they make it out to be. You will either get a perfect hand on a level and beat it smoothly, or you waste 10k+ to best one level because you pull 5 "3" cards in a row when you need one more card to best the level. It is just luck, the powerups do very little to help. Truly terrible and very predatory micro transactions.

I love the game, but currently, the animals players can feed cookies to keep on the farm are too hard to obtain. I understand the need for high stakes so that players are motivated to play more often to win the animals, but with the current settings, they seem unobtainable.

I have been been playing since 2021. I don't play often anymore, way too many pop-ups. When I do play, it is on x1, anymore than that and it is wasting coins. It would be nice to be able to insert the wilds or windmills ourselves, when we need them, not just put randomly by the game. Decrease the amount of pop-ups, you will lose more players in the end if you don't. No need to add your auto response, as many people have said the same thing and it doesn't change!

Well I had to come back and redo this review as I have since decided to delete my account reason being. Players please beware when playing solitaire farm, I have been having issues with my amount being added after spinning the wheel and or doing the pic 4. it does no good also to contact support as they are of no help. Of course they say their records shows differently, even after sending them proof of what you are referring too. I sent screenshots as well as screen records and yet, nothing.

More than 20 tries at one level after lvl number 400. Used all my boosters. One time, last card was remaining and no relevant card appears in the last 10 plus deck cards. Very disappointing, I am stuck on just one level for few days now. On top of that, they reduced daily free market coins from 2,500 to 1000 only. This is depressing and unbearable.

Love this game. Play it daily and even have my kids play it with me. review update 4/30/26 I dont play this game as much. its been about the last year or so, that as soon as you open the app, 20 different pop up bubbles come up. you exit one, and here comes another one. I just want to be able to click a level and play without having to see pop ups for in game purchases. I understand thats how the game keeps going, but if I need to purchase something, I know where to go.

Fun but it gets harder as you progress, and the free coins aren't enough to help. The game is made to get you hooked, and then you have to buy coins to keep playing. Update. This game makes it so difficult to win the grand crop album prize. The only way to do it is to keep buying more and more credits; it's ridiculous. It seems the more you buy, the harder it gets to win.

It's a fun game, but there comes a point that you can barley win. It starts wining a lot, then just dwindles your coins even when you're winning. I was looking for a better option to Disney Solitaire and Domino Dreams, but it works the same way. It's all about the in app purchases

Warning. A waste if youre playing for money. This game is just like Domino Dreams, the set up is the exact same way. So if youre on a time limit dont do it! You will be sucked not only out of money to meet your goal but out of huge amount of time. After an hour I uninstalled and ran.

The game, of course is a fun game, the only thing I don't like about it is having to pay money! I know I haven't put real money into it, but eventually it will be that way when and if I to lose. I think that is why I uninstalled it a few years ago. I didn't want to be tempted to pay money to continue. I'll play this game to get my Google play points, but when I have to fork out money I'm going to uninstall it again. Again, It Is A Fun Game!

I started playing thru Pogo, have been logging on daily, because you can only do one level a day unless you pay for it or get lucky with the in game coins. opened it today and it restarted my daily login... it's bad enough as is, you're gonna do that when I long in daily or sometimes 2x a day just to see if I can get enough to play ONE SINGLE ROUND of this game?? do better, are y'all kidding.

garbage. it's not even solitaire. it's like if you showed a newborn 5 seconds of solitaire gameplay then made them explain what they saw to a coder who then made this. gameplay isn't great either. cards drawn are purely luck based. a bad draw of cards (very common) leads to your score tanking because you literally can't do anything.

only dled this game just because of the 50 points it gives. the only solitaire I play is the Microsoft version just because I spent the majority of my time on that version and I also got an Xbox/Microsoft acc and gamepass to play and earn achievements. there's ads without GP and you can even get free solitaire sub/GP on MS rewards. while this game is unique in a mobile game sort of way, it isn't my cup of tea just because there is a tutorial on how to play pyramid, tri peak, etc.

It would be fun if the player could at least pretend like they were making a bit of progress here and there, but the game is clearly designed so the player loses pretty much right away, and then the pop ups start coming to purchase more coins. It's too boring of a game to invest any money into.

wish I could give 0 stars this game is so not fun takes 2-3 days to beat a level so greedy change the name to BS solitaire I would never buy any packages it's boring and not fun I'm on level 48716 it used to be fun not no more it's all about buying greedy you can make it a little easier but you don't edit it's not 1 level it's most levels whats the sense of playing if you can't win anything no events or levels and a level takes weeks or months to win worst solitaire game greedy

really enjoy playing this game but i have noticed with the recent updates you can no longer play older levels and the harvest bonus has been reduced to current crop levels. I use to enjoy going back to old levels to try and collect more stars, now I can't go back any further then the current crop group.😞

I am quite far in the game, but almost every time I watch an ad for any kind of bonus or reward, the app crashes and doesn't apply the bonus. I have cleared the cache multiple times, but that doesn't help. it was operating fine until the past few weeks. I check the app store for updates, but there never are any.

Been playing for a long time, but now too many pop-ups, have not gotten a good wheel spin, payouts are small, cost to buy a card too high. Please increase win amounts and decrease the cost for extra cards!!!

I've played over 15 chest and not one had a double round in it. cheating @$$ game. edit to say: they got rid of the double rounds which would help those of us with barely any coins to play. game has gone down the toilet. not fun anymore. about ready to delete and free myself like I did monopoly

it's a fun cute game, I like it what I don't like is the pay yo play....everything costs coins....go into a world pay, par for 5 extra, pay for wild card...it's like I'm at a casino they always take more than they give....the toss you options to buy more coins with real money, I get you gotta make money but do you have to make it feel like Ned Beatty in deliverance?

EDIT: Once you reach level 275 and above it takes 7 to 10 tries to clear if you use no bonuses. Needed a 3 or 5 to clear last card and got K,K,Q,K,9,6,10,10...just a joke! Your typical cash grab app. Some levels are almost impossible unless you use alot of your coins. Winning a level doesn't really grant you more coins, you might wind up with a lot less.

fabulous if a bit frustrating due to so many ads. if I didn't have other money concerns, I'd totally buy my brains out bc advancing is very slow wo more moolah. especially for the extra scenes and games. honestly, beats disney solitaire. its cute, easy (on leveler +1), fun. no complaints bc I live and benefit from a capitalist nation. the work around for ads (airplane mode) prevents hourly harvest so I just strap on my big girl panties and resist temptations. you'd have to set yourself a budget

Too many pop-ups getting in the way to collect coins. If you get a time reward from a harvest task or collection, the credits are shorted. Caveat, always collect rewards before going to social media for additional credits.

Purley pay to play scam. 1 game every hour maximum. to have to pay unreasonable amount of coins where your set up to fail is ridiculous. I had a 7 left my next 6 cards were unusable and this is every level. Have to remove game which is a shame its beautiful and was fun at first.

I really love the game but the farther you get the more expensive it gets. I've spent a lot of money on this game and you would think you would get some sort of reward for spending so much money but instead you get punished and have to spend a ridiculous amount of money just to keep playing. Come on guys do better for your loyal customers.

***Edited to add***No clue how I missed the most important thing - THERE'S GENUINELY NO ADS!!*** Is a really addictive game. Bit glitchy which is frustrating (don't always get things won on the dice boards) and what is with the prices of the boosters jumping from 3X to 1X?! 1X is affordable and useable... 3X is if you win 100k on the wheel.... so never 😂 get it sorted.... it's been like this for months. Rating will improve if things get fixed 👍
Very Enjoyable, Great Graphics! It lags a bit, in response to hitting on cards, reducing Stars earned, seemingly according to quick action. Nothing that can't be fixed. All in all, excellent fun!

Loved the animals faces and how you really had to apply your thinking in order to solve what position the numbers had to proceed into . Thus moving on to solve the farms problems and its cute , funny and a challenge , you wouldnt be disappointed my freinds.

game is great but it takes so much to keep your new farm animals unless you purchase extra 🍪 and some people can't afford that fixed in budget is tight. there is always an update every so often but other than these things it's a good game. Just wish the farm animals we could keep with not so much of a hassle.

It's fine, I suppose. You get exactly what it says on the tin, but the coins that you need to play a level are so few and far between that it starts to feel like the developers can't rush you OFF their app quickly enough! It seems if you're not willing to remortgage your home to buy coins, you'll be granted the awesome gift of one-to-three games a day before you run out of coins and have to wait at least an hour to get any more.

I like playing but progress levels should be there without leaving the game to check. Completed tasks and $ earned should be part of the progress you've made. Once I leave to check my progress in the parent game I usually end up playing something else. You also need a tutorial on how to progress. I don't have a clue what it takes to finish a crop.

I love this game before, but now make me stress, I keep the coins for 3 days but I spent only for one level, I stuck in one level for two days and that make me angry and stress, this game is not fun anymore, they have pop-up and you need to buy some coins to continue to play, and when you run out of coins they offer to play a lite mode but in this light mode you play 10x but you only win once and the prize is small, and about the pet cookies is too much to complete until the 5 stage

I love to play this game, but I don't feel the rewards are adequate enough to keep me entertained. The rewards always fall short of what I need to continue the game and it makes me become quickly uninterested when I feel like the game only goes well when I have to purchase more credits. Could be better.

game is a COMPLETE cash grab. think disney solitaire and domino dreams but somehow worse than both combined. Don't waste your time on this game and it's rigged levels. I started doing this for a Swagbucks offer that requires something like level 187 (Crop 11) completion in only 14 days. If it wasn't for attempting to complete that offer, I'd have ditched this game on day one. My personal experience has been the 'ol bait and switch. I won for the first few levels, but starting around level 5 I began to lose almost each and every level, most times requiring 5 times to finally get a win. And guess what? That 1000-1500 gold you pay to attempt each level? You will have to pay that for every attempt. Sure you get to pay a few thousand more for the other two higher tiers as you level up to get more gems and win more, but you will still lose a hell of a lot more than you'll win. For instance, try paying 4000 to play a "grand" game. You'll ultimately spend 20k to win maybe like 5k on the 5th attempt. You get very few power ups, which will be used very quickly, and by all means keep checking SGH's Facebook page. If you're lucky they'll give you a scrap of 1-2k coins or a free play or something once in a day ( I've played other games that will at least give you something a few times in a day). I am on day 5 and am currently at level 65, and it has been hell because I lose every single time. By all means Harvest when you have time to check your phone every hour, but it won't help much with the losses. I like to make sure an offer is undoable, so I'm going to wait and see where I am in a couple of days, and if you're also doing this for an offer for Swagbucks or something, by all means test your luck ( but don't spend any real money! I never spend real money on these offers and if I did, this would be the worst choice). If you're just looking for something fun, I strongly advise you to run fast, and run far. I enjoy word games and bubble popping games personally. Anything would be more fun than this. On a more positive note, if this game would just have some fair balance, it would actually be a good way to kill some time.

I'd say it's pay to win, but you'll make so little progress regardless. If you make a purchase, it will help you complete no more than 2 levels. Fun way to kill time if it doesn't kill your bank account first. It's great in the beginning when you have a huge stash of coins and the task to earn more are simple. Only good thing about this game is that it knows what it is and doesn't hide it. Another sad mobile "free" game with a massive paywall. Nearly unplayable unless you spend money on it. I played this game for a few days, everything worked fine.... then, all of a sudden, today the game is freezing & I can't get past the "Daily Goodies" screen. Now I have over 200,000 credits that I can't use. I've noticed a few other people complaining about the game freezing... if this glitch cannot be fixed, the game shouldn't be available to install. Also, fair warning... after level 100, be prepared to spend lots of credits to continue progress. Btw credits will cost you cash or you'll spend a lot of time waiting & checking for "harvest" to gain a few credits.

I truly don't recommend downloading this game. I love solitaire, don't get me wrong, but this game wants you to spend money. Everything you spend coins on is priced WAY to high. Buying powerups?? Good luck. Need help on a level, forget about it. Unless you want to spend $20 for 30k coins each time you run out, be my guest. If this game was made to truly enjoy, I wouldn't have an issue with anything. but the developers made this game as a money maker. Don't waste your time on this game.

Frustrating as many others have opined. This is ridiculous that you can't move forward more than once in a span of hours and in some cases, days. I'm not buying any of the offers for more points, coins, whatever as you go through them faster than the time taken to make the purchase. It is a money (and time and patience) grab and I think it's time to uninstall this game.

Finally finished with this game. The additional add-on games that are supposed to add to the game have become ridiculous. Cannot even earn enough coins or stars to finish without paying. So disappointing 😞 These supposed improvements are more distracting. One thing at a time always worked in the past. No longer happy at all with this game.

This is a great concept with the iconic character collaborations and the spin on Solitaire. But I can only play one level every hour. Still Stuff is so expensive on the game and to play you start out a thousand coins and when you get to around level thirty or before it's costing twenty thousand or more the boosters are more expensive then the game! How sad that I'm not the only one who has watched this game progress from a fun game with beatable levels, costing next to nothing, to a game where you can win 1/4 tries, if you're lucky. I absolutely love the game solitaire. But this game cost so much game money for each level. I am on level 65. Anyone who plays games knows that not many and i have been playing for over a week. Could easily be a 5 star game I love it! Used to play a lot recently started playing again and the prices are crazy! It's honestly a good game, but they are so money hungry. There are no ads, but that's because they advertise their own deals after EVERY screen. It's fun, but I think that they should do hearts to play games and not use money. Even though it's somewhat nice if you have a lot of money so you can play lots of games. it's more about spending money than playing for fun. You run out of lives quickly.

Game is alot of fun but the higher levels the more it cost. The coins you recieve every hour (which is to long to wait) is not even enough to play next level on higher levels. Would not recommend it to anyone over 5. The gameplay itself is fine, though the fact that you are so often stuck with a stockpile of cards that do nothing can suck. Also, I don't like the pig.

The game was fun at the beginning. However, the more you win, the more you lose. The multiplier works well but when adding the credits, the tax man gets his first. Game is impossible to play without purchasing coins. I believe this is unfair. No other options or ad watching is available. Other reviews I've read state that higher levels cost more than the harvest amount. Meaning even longer waits just to make one attempt. But, if you want to be forced to pay, have fun.

By the time I got to level 80, I had ran out of coins. You then have to wait until harvest to collect more or spend money. I downloaded the Tripeaks farm game. Same exact concept. I'm new to the game, enjoyed it at first but then quickly realized that from 1,000 coins to 2,000 coins per game... I think that ridiculous... Great and shiny graphics, however after level 50 the game becomes really hard and tedious to play unless you spend money (not to mention you'll literally get like 3 pop-ups telling you to buy packs when you open the game). There are too many pop-ups for in-game purchases. too many levels, that when you have a lot of coins, take those coins back, or seemingly have no solution. plus in game power ups are getting too pricey with in-game coins. feels like more motivated for pay to play. plus, the promotions and events are way too short to be of any use or fun. I have been playing for quite some time (almost level 800) but I too will be done playing soon as this game is designed to only force you to purchase coins. The amount of coins it takes to play a level even at the smallest volume is absurd. By the time you use your coins to play a level and win your gain in coins is little to none. Decent time killer but after a while you don't even earn enough coins per hour to play 1 puzzle per hour. Would be better to go the candy crush route and give players lives per hour. At least then they'd get to play your game..

Really nice graphics, but that's about where the pros end for this game. Very soon, you find that you are unable to play at all without buying more coins or waiting to claim daily coins. In short, it is an EXPENSIVE pay-to-play AND pay-to-win game with no tangible rewards to receive.

I liked this game at first, it was fun. Once you get to around level 35-40ish, it uses more and more coins to play each game and you can barely play anymore. Slow--I find myself checking often to see if I'm still connected. I got it from a earn money playing games site--I played it before and found it fine so sure--but it's not worth the frustration.

I've been playing this game for YEARS. Unfortunately, with the last update, I'm unable to open the app to play. It loads to nearly 30% then crashes. I can't get to the support option in the app, so I contacted support via email - 5 days ago - and haven't heard back. 1 star for support, 4 stars for the game - the pop-ups are annoying (I've gone from +1M coins to 10k in the same day from repeatedly losing the same level), and it's hard to win the additional games/tasks, but overall it's fun.

This is truly a pay for play game. Fun experience if you shell out money and only then. In addition, I wish the makers of the game could decide how many coins it takes to play each time. For example when you play for the first day it costs less per game that it will the next day and the next day etc. Also even when you buy coins, you cannot purchase boosters with them, only play. If you want boosters you have to buy more coins. $$$ hungry creators. Ugh. There's better games out there.

This is one of my favorite games and some days would play all day if I could. But there is a problem when it comes to enough coins to play several rounds of the game. I very seldom earn card packs for the side card game and can't hardly make it around the dice game any more. So sad because I have to play somebody elses game instead.

Starts out as an easy, fun game, but quickly progresses to luck based card placement and expensive credit prices. On a serious note, just out to get your money. There is no real game play after level ~60 without paying real money or waiting 3+ days to progress.

If I could, i'd rate it 0 stars. I play maybe 1 round an hour because the game rarely gives you the right cards to play. When you end up losing your coins, you have to wait an hour to collect more. In order to get those, you collect every hour until you have enough. Takes too long to wait to play one round.

This game sucks. You gotta pay in-game money to play a level. It could have been fine if the level could be completed on skill alone. But no, there's a luck factor that come into play. Used to be great, now it's ridiculous. You spend 1500 too play one level and win 1700. Anyone see a problem? You get to harvest every hour but that only gets you more money if you won levels. A watch add for coins would be helpful also. Dice roll should be permanent. Actually, most of the mini games should be permanent, so there are other ways to get coins other than the harvest. This game would probably have fewer people uninstalling if it were easier to get coins. Hope these changes come, cause I'm getting bored.

Great game but really really expensive to play. The higher level you go the cards are stacked against you so you lose faster and the cost of play is over 33k credits. It stops being fun when you feel like it is just about taking your money. I'm starting to feel ripped off which is my own fault. I like the game but trying to find one that you don't have to buy credits to play.

I always enjoyed this game, played every day. But lately the developers seem to be getting more and more greedy. Prizes have become ridiculously small, you cannot even win enough coins at the diamond crate for one game anymore. Coins are now so expensive I simply cannot afford to waste so much money on a game. I am really disappointed as this was one of my favourite games.

This game stole money from me twice! I bought two $5.99 final days packs, I was never given my purchase, I have sent FIVE different emails to support, I have uploaded screenshots of where the money was taken from me,they HAVE NOT even had the decency to email me back. I have checked all including spam and nothing, I left a review elsewhere where a developer responded and just said send another email. This is ridiculous, I am owed atleast 190,000 coins, as well as the 1.2 million reward for stick

This was a great game. But, I'm getting more annoyed with it. It's such a money grab. It's getting impossible and expensive to pass levels, and i am only around level 4620. I can't fathom how many coins will be needed to play later levels. Do not expect to pass a level on your own... or, even when using power-ups, TO many instances with 1 or, 2 cards left on a level (that I already used a power up on), went through three or more +5 card plays to try to complete and nothing.. I'm over it!

I'm giving up on this game It was okay for at the beginning - really fun. But, just spent real money for the piggy bank - can't win a game at all. In 10 minutes, lost all the coins I bought. Bought the windmill that blows the cards away twice, they didn't show up in the game. Lost my coins on that purchase. I haven't won a game without at least 6-7 tries in days. Just too hard to win a game. Giving up. Not fun anymore. Okay - played 5 games. Lost. Uninstalling.

Was a great game never had issues. But in the last month or 2 I have had nothing but issues. Taking forever to load in, freezes, and randomly kicks u out of game or restarts and steals your money. I have lost about a million $$ in game now because of this. It's sucks as this is the only game I play and am thinking of soon uninstalling it if I don't get repayed back for what was lost due to the game issues and if the issues don't all get fixed.

Three months ago, I would have given it 5 stars. Today, not so much. The creators have gotten greedy. The only way to really proceed, is to make in app purchases and they are not cheap. There are no .99 cent purchases. I'm talking 4.99, 5.99, 8.99 and those don't even last that long. Every hour you harvest crops, I for example harvest 14k in credits, to play a top level, it costs me 56k! If you are lucky, you can win a 30 minute timer (instead of an hour), but those are harder to come by now. They say the game is random, I disagree. I have never picked or spun for the top prizes. You can purchase a second spin for 4.99, but they lowered some of the prizes. The wheel would show 20xDouble credits. That has been lowered to 10x, but as mentioned earlier, I never win the better prizes anyways. Carrie the rabbit used to give you a wild card plus everything else if you were 5/5. She stopped doing that. When I first started playing, they had a side game you rolled a die to go around a board. Prizes on the board used to be 1k, 2k, 3k. Now they are 100 and 250. Don't even get me started on the costs of gems to build your farm. That is a whole other rip off! They disappointed me, I really used to love this game.

Typical of games of this type, it gets ridiculously hard at higher levels so you will pay to play. For me, it happened at level 170. It takes approximately 10 times to pass these levels and the revenue generated from farming does nothing to keep your entry fee available. Once it gets frustrating, delete this game and find another one.

Pretty awesome game. The game is very quick to catch on to, progressing is fun and just the right amount of difficulty. The cost to play a level is very high in some cases when you hardly make a couple 100 more than needed to play the next but that's my only big criticism. The levels are designed well and power-ups aren't too ridiculously powerful to make things too simple. Very extensive amount of levels and crops to discover. Overall fun experience and I'd recommend it to any solitaire lovers.

I love this game, very addicting. However, game play is very expensive. The coins pay out is considerable less compared to the cost to pay each level. Definitely feel screwed over bc to get fun game play, your gonna have to spend money on coins. Even then the purchase of coins doesn't take you very far bc the super high costs. Very disappointing:(

I played this game consistently for many months, then I got busy and didn't have much time to play. I CONSTANTLY GET LOUD ADDS for me to play until I tap the x on the top. I uninstalled it and the adds keep on coming. Even while talking with someone, playing other games, and even bingo games which messes up what I'm doing no matter what!! The notification is off and it keeps on coming. I'm really getting angry now to the point of saying I may NEVER play that game again!! Please help!!!

If you like pop-ups... this is your game. There have been so many complaints about the pop-ups so they double down and add MORE! Try to go in and collect coins just to be bombarded with pop-ups... So frustrating! Not a fun experience for a game. Years of play about to be deleted. Ready to uninstall!!!

Fun and addictive. The upper levels raise the difficulty to the point where you have to try a dozen times just to complete one level. You can complain to the Developers who will tell you that you can always buy a wild-card... at 30k apiece. Or you can uninstall the game and find another game to play!

Cash Grab You lose coins while you play. You have to pay for everything to be able to progress. Feels like it's programed for you to lose over and over again. It's simply a luck of the draw on the cards you get. But unlike actual solitaire, it seems like the cards are random and you're at the whim of the programming to give you a decent deck to solve the puzzle. Only downloaded to get perks for another game. Uninstalling due to the sheer boldness of trying to force players to spend.

Fun game, unfortunately, the longer you play, the more the game will crash or freeze. I've contacted support several times, and I was given directions on what to do to stop this, and I did as instructed. Then it happens again. I do not expect the creator or IT to be able to reimburse me if I put more money into game.the I figured at least with screenshots and details of exactly what coins I used, they would at least be able to reimburse the loss to continue playing. Play at own risk.

Rewards are ridiculously low. Just to give you an example, if you pet the dog you only get up to 500 coins which is nothing. Buying more cards will eat all your coins and you end up without enough coins to finish the game. Sometimes you end up with only one card on the board and no cards to flip, and no more coins!!! In this case it would be nice to provide the option to watch an Ad to gain 5 more cards to flip and maybe finish the game.

Lots of fun. But it is without doubt the most expensive to play game out there. The rewards are a small fraction above the cost of playing. If you have to buy any "cheats" they are marked 100% above the prizes. The game is rigged so if you make a purchase it will let you win easily about 8 games. Then it makes it to where you have to purchase cheats to win. Major expensive do not recommend unless you are part of the 1%.

This game is unequivocally awful. Beware, it's a money trap and the developers do not care about anything but getting as much money from you as possible. The games are unwinnable, the rewards don't cut it, and the game is rigged so the only real "free" part is downloading it onto your phone. I have played this game for years and have been totally disappointed. Do not play this game!

I used to love the game but lately it seems they are purposely setting it up so you have to spend real money to progress. It went from being fun to stressful, which is the opposite of what a game should be. I usually play several times a day but haven't had very much progress. I will have one or two cards left to clear in the game and over 20+ cards left in my reserve pile but somehow none of those 20+ cards are useful. I also got not getting coins for my achievements as I should.

I had a cash back option to get to crop 15 to get 40 dollars. So I decided sure why not. This game is a joke it started off fun but it quickly becomes an attempt at spending actual money. The fact that it charges coins to even play a level is a joke. Then when you want to go back a card it costs you money. BASICALLY EVERYTHING COSTS MONEY!!!!! I am not even going to bother to waste my time to get to crop 15 as it was would be exactly what I said a waste of time. You have been warned!!!!

This game is a cash sucker. It starts off great. Winning and getting decent rewards for that win. Until you make that first purchase because you need more coins to play. Once you do that, it seems like it gets harder to win. Prices go up? Dumb. Levels are obviously rigged. Ya, ya..."we offer ways to earn more coins through puzzles, challenges", blah blah blah. Well you have to be able to win to get the rewards from those extras. Costing 50k coins to win a 1 star win at the lowest level. Dumb.

The game takes more money than it pays out! To get a wild card or 5 extra cards is 2 to 4 times more than what one round costs. The Harvest pays out enough for one round, game, yet everything else is way to expensive to help you win a round. The game sucks out more money than it pays out and you're left waiting hours and days just to build enough money to play just a few rounds. They should make harvesting a LOT more money so we can play longer. It's a relaxing game but I've lost interest!

I used to like this game and play it a lot but it has gotten ridiculous. There are so many errors and it takes too many coins to play one turn. You don't earn coins fast enough in order to play a turn so that leads you to decide to purchase more coins if you want but then the purchase runs out fast due to the game requiring too many coins to play. And if you do decide to make a purchase there are errors so the purchase does not go throug. It's just too much so I will stop playing this game.

Game is real buggy...sometimes have to restart multiple times for it to even run. I also have game fields the have " blacked" out cards and some times all the cards are blacked out. These problems did not start until got further in the game. Very disappointed and may just delete. Update: 7FEB2021 The last update has made the game unplayable. I try to start the game and it takes you coins and shuts down. If i could give this app a negative 5 stars i would.

The game is okay for a little bit. Some of the things I wish they would change for one instance the image of the 24-hour rocket. It is deceptive makes you think you're either getting 24 hour of free gameplay or 24-hour of crops harvested at one time. Also wish the free turn that you get wish that they did not use automatically and you had the choice whether to pay coins or use each time. And also since you get the free turns you should be able to use it for either the 1st,2nd,or 3rd rank.

I love this game! The only downfall is it cost alot of gold coins to play and there should be some extra games or events to win these gold coins, bc sometimes I can only play two games at a time. The graphics are great and no lagging. Ease add extra credit games to win more coins, so you can play more than two games at a time! When you do that, I will give you 5 stars!

I'm playing this game to earn currency for another game, and while I love the concept (I love soliatre), there is an issue I have with the game. It cost coins to play which is fine, but you don't really earn anything when you beat a level. They game would be a lot more enjoyable if you actually won a decent amount of coins for beating a level.

I have had this app downloaded for a couple years and now I'm giving up. It just gets worse! The more "improvements" they make, the more difficult it is to enjoy the game. I have now played my coins to zero (didn't take long) and have deleted the game. Ridiculously difficult and frustrating. I play these games to have fun for FREE, not stress and waste money.

I do love the game! ! I find they make items too high unnecessarily though. Why would you make me spend 51,000 coins for a wild on a game I will make no more than 20,000 on? Makes you not want to purchase cause it appears to be a form of coin guzzling in order to get you to run out quicker and have to purchase more at quicker rate. I purchase from the game... But makes me not want to at all.

Fun game of planting and harvesting crops while playing an excellent game of solitaire! my low score is because of the outrageous amount they require for 5 extra cards (over 7,000 right now) and for a wild card (11,000)!!!!! The game gives you around 3,000 points at harvest but uses up that amount for next play. it requires that you spend money if you want to play longer than 15 minutes.

Disappointing when you get to the upper levels. Seems to be no way to win some of the levels until the software decides you have tried enough times, and as they get harder the opportunities for points also decline. I'm happy to watch ads for extra points but they even restrict those. They just really want you to pay to play and I won't, so am probably going to delete this.

I love this game but it gets to the point where you absolutely have to spend money to continue the game at a reasonable pace. First thing in the morning you'll win the first 2 or 3 levels right of the bat then after that you are literally stuck on the same level till the next day unless you spend money to get extra coins. Extremely disappointed

Yes, this game can be played for free but it gets frustrating. I'm around level 1,370, and it costs 5,000 credits just to play one level. Wild cards cost at least 15,000 credits, and I'm not sure how many credits it costs to use the undo feature. When I have the time (and also remember to do this), I spend a day or two just harvesting and collecting the daily bonus (which is now up to 10,000 credits per day). Also, it can take several days to finish one level without buying credits.

Every time a new feature or event is instslled by you to the game, I lose the ability to open my game! It stops right at the start of the game where the daily bonuses are given. And all but final box is left. And there it stays. I've been 3 days now not being able to play. This is second time in a month or so it has happened.... I am not a happy person! All glitches gone! Now I don't have to play 2nd choice games! I play this game for hours. I even put it in my monthly budget!

Have been playing this game for quite a long time now and up to level 1675. The last 6 to 8 months have been shocking. Most days can't even get daily reward before it freezes. On the few occasions that I am able to play a game it usually takes 4-5 minutes just to play one game due to it constantly freezing. A great game that is now unplayable. Please don't tell me that you are working on it as it's been messing up for far to long. Suggestion-get rid of it. Time to uninstall unfortunately!!!!

The game was fun enough; however, the pay to play each level using game currency gets really rediculous. As you progress through the game to higher levels, it costs more and more to play each one and that gets to a ridiculously high point. Yes, you make more money with crops at higher levels and win a level, but this becomes an irritating process just to play a game that is very chance based and thus easy to lose a level. Playing each level was definitely fun, just less cost per level prefer.

I loved the card games and the graphics, but the cost in earned coins began to make it so you had to wait a day between playing a game or two, in order to build up enough coins to play. Often, I'd "buy" the suggested boaters and pay at a higher level, and then spend the rest of my amassed coins buying extra cards in order to pass a level, and STILL it wouldn't let me win. So in frustration, I finally deleted it and went looking for a game that would be less aggravating.

Very fun game, but it's very much a pay-to-win game. It's near impossible to pass any levels after a while without paying for a package of coins or other help. Yes, you can harvest every hour (manually, I might add, so you need to open the app every hour) for free coins, but once you get to around level 100 or so, a full 24 hours of harvesting still won't get you enough to play much more than a couple levels. I've just uninstalled the game because it's getting too frustrating.

As of today, they have made it impossible to finish levels in the 10,000+ range without spending money. The diamond crates give you maybe ~100k worth of things, and each level costs ~100k. I loved this game, and had competed in the masters league and all. Really sad that they'd get rid of the only way to be able to beat these levels, but they finally removed the ability to perform the "hack"

I used to love this game. I am on level 9042 and have been playing for a few years. Lately I've noticed everything is changing to get you to spend money to win a level. They want you to play at the highest level but the hourly bonus is not rewarded at the highest level. It takes 7 or 8 hourly bonuses to even play a higher level. Also I noticed it is now skipping over the spinning wheel bonus and end of harvest bonus,making you wait even longer to collect your harvest. Very disappointed.

Found this game on mistplay, I like the idea, it's fun and full of interesting things to look at, on the other hand, once you're out of coins, which happens pretty quickly, there's nothing else to do in the game but wait for your next harvest. I would recommend making harvests more frequent and maybe reducing the cost or eliminating the cost on some of the in match actions.

I've been playing this game fore some time and I love it. However, after the latest update, there are many glitches. Today, 3 times I went to play a level, and it would take my coins, but the shut down. 3 times at almost 60,000 coins each adds up pretty quickly! I also find it's costing too many coins to play a level. Please fix the glitches.

It's a good fun game. Some thing could be different for when you can't play online. You should still be able to use the diamonds to build, the harvest time could be shorter instead of an hour and that's for on or offline. The games could cost less to play, and you should be able to get more power up things to help you in your games. Other than that the game is alright. Not the best but most def not the worst. I like this game just wish some things would or could be different.

I used to love playing. Now I am just completely frustrated and have deleted it for a second time. I was #1 in the Strawberry collection this weekend. Something booted me out of the game and when I came back I was at #46. Closing the game and reentering it did nothing. I am finally done with this greedy game. I had over 4,000,000 credits when I started building my Farm for the new quest this weekend. I came within a few tasks of completing the entire thing, but I am now so frustrated I give up. It costs way to many credits to do a round and the cost of wild cards is ridiculous. The game doesn't want you to win without spending money.

this is one of the best solitaire games i have ever played. There is lots of levels and they are not cheap ln the amount of coins you get. I have been going on 4 years and im in the high level of 6800. It is really hard and when you purchase coins they go really fast. Some levels you add 5 extra cards at least 3 times and still dont win. Thats 15 extra, and you have to keep purchasing coins. The more you purchase the more you lose.

So unfortunate that this game has gone downhill. I'm uninstalling on my phone and going to try on my tablet... this has been a favorite game for years... and now it's basically unplayable, with pop up after pop up inviting me to click on things I don't want to click on, and it keeps freezing on me... I appreciate that the game doesn't have ads, and it's really a fun and relaxing game, when it works.

my favorite solitaire game of this style, and that's saying something! I am very into solitaire and have tried many apps. not only is the farm concept adorable, it's all very well executed. no waiting on lives, or being forced to watch ads for extra cards! it's all coins. and not only are they earnable vie crops and winning levels, you are started off with a very generous amount. my only issue so far is that sometimes I pay for extra cards and none of them help at all. I once had to buy 4 batches extra because the first 3 had no helpful cards.

I love this game, and all the mini games. Unfortunately the game is a money grab. And you do not always earn what you pay for. I paid $5.99 for a spin and did not get the spin. I also lost a gopher challenge, which is a free mini challenge to earn coins to play. The algorithm is set up to only reward people who pay. After the newness wears off, you will uave to pay to play, to advance. Not worth it.!! FYI Wooga has games where you can earn and sustain lay without spending any money!

Was fun until the cost to buy points got totally out of control, and the amount of points to play a round did the same thing. Also, it isn't long until you can see the gimmicks used to force you to purchase points or lose significant progress. Too bad they got this greedy. I deleted it and actually feel some relief. Wish I had the money back that I paid over the years. My mistake, so please think carefully players.. There's many games to have fun that don't rob you blind but this isn't one.

Somehow this game has changed. I had to download it again on a new phone and it's almost impossible to beat. I've seen other reviews like this and the only response is "yeah solitaire can be a challenging game." This has surpassed challenging and is just plain ridiculous to beat some levels. Please attempt to recalibrate the cards so it can be fun again. (Yes, I know I need to harvest to get coins and everything else). How about listening to the complaints?

Love this game. Have been playing it since 2018. As of late though it's been freezing up right after I get into a level. I have no option but to loose the coins I spent and restart it. There has also been issues with not receiving the correct bonuses. I know there have been updates and I'm use to it taking a day or 2 to fix the issues, but this has been going on for weeks now. It's getting frustrating.

Unfortunately the game is fun and would be fun to progress in. Getting more difficult is part of it, but it's not long when it's impossible to win unless you spend money. It'll take 10+ attempts to possibly get a soluble solution, only for one star. You can see the pattern with the cards on how they're dealt. It's expected for games to push buying perks/lives, but not simply to play. Disappointing. Has potential for long term, but the tactics are blatantly cheap, forceful, and just insulting.

I really do like the game, but why is everything so expensive?? If everything wasn't so expensive I would actually spend real money in the game. But when they charge for EVERYTHING, even just to play a hand and it takes several times playing to win a hand sometimes, that gets very expensive, very quickly so I refuse to give real money anymore. But if the tokens would last for any amount of time I would actually make more purchases because it is a very fun game. Please fix this!

Sad to see the negative reviews! I think the game is great! I know some people don't like the coin system but I just go one day without playing (so hard because I love to play) to let my coins add up. There are also lots of giveaways on Facebook. And there is an option to watch an ad for saving/ earning more...and it's optional. I definitely recommend this game!

This game has become so frustrating. Harvesting your crops will only get you enough coins to play one round. Up in the 4000 levels of the game this is one try every hour. Used to be able to watch an ad and play 2 rounds. Thats now gone. Levels are taking 8 to 10 attempts to win at times. Boosts are very few, mini games can take a lot of coins to win, and unless you pay to play you can be stuck on levels for a long time. I don't pay to play. Developers don't seem to care. Read the reviews

I love the game but an hour wait between harvests is a bit long. Now that I am into the 3000 level, it appears that certain levels are designed to not allow you to achieve more than one or two stars no matter how many times you play that level or how many power-ups you use. Since my last posting I have learned how the cost of each level is calculated. The lowest level is equal to the harvest, the middle level is 2X the harvest, and the highest is about 3.3X the harvest. This breaks us quickly.

Nice game, u get credits quite easily in this game. But you lose them very quickly too. You get like 1000 credits per win and every time you start a level u need to pay like 1000-3,500 credits so if you dont win it in the first try you lose credits. The other thing that doesnt make sense is that, for example I play a level perfectly, leaving about 10 cards in my hand for the last 2 or 3 cards. And i cant get through the level because none of these extra 10 cards can be used with the cards left..

The graphics are great! I've changed my rating as the rewards have decreased significantly and the cost of power ups have increased significantly! 132,000 coins for one wild card, outrageous!! It seems as if the prices have changed almost on a daily basis! The only way to win the diamond crate is when Carrie is available even those rewards have become cheap! I've been a fan for a very long but will be looking for a new game

Winning a level pays minimum points, frustrating. As you progress thru game you spend more points to play each game and reward is too low. Actually need to spend real $$ to access certain scenarios to win more points. Seems that the better you do the less you benefit pointwise. I've played alot and spent real $$. Nice graphics. Tired of having to pay to play certain options of game. So if you don't mind paying real $$ this may be a game choice for you.

I love the different challenges. But I don't understand why many times none of the cards in the draw pile are playable to help you try to complete the challenge? You have just wasted money, which already the levels cost too much to play. Also the cost of getting 5 more cards is WAY TOO MUCH and if that's not bad enough it increases to an even more ridiculous amount. The same thing as well for the reverse and wild cards.

I really loved this game at the beginning. Im on level 306 but it took me FOREVER to get there. The cost to play a round just keeps getting higher and higher and the payout is barely enough to cover the next round. Some levels are impossible to beat the first time or without the "helper cards" (which cost even more rediculous amounts of coins) given the cards they give you. And even with the helper cards its about a 50/50 shot you'll get anything helpful. Please fix the coin cost issue.

The game is not fun anymore. The beginning of it was fine and fun, but it starts to become just a way to waste money. The levels increase in price, making it so that every hour you can only play one round, the levels are made to be nearly impossible, the prizes are miniscule compared to the cost of levels, and for right handed people, we can accidentally spend money or use powerups in the game, like an accidental undo that we can't fix, or the use of a wild card we didn't want to use. :I 0/10.

I enjoy playing. But, the thing I don't like is that it seems like if you don't spend $, then you don't win as much and you have to play the same level 5-10 times before you are allowed to move on. Also, the fact that you can only get coins once an hour without paying for them and it's only enough to play 2 rounds if you're lucky is annoying. The colors and graphics are nice and vibrant though. :)

It's fun until you must pay to play. Each section requires more coins to play. At level 300, the perks you win aren't enough to sustain free play. At level 400, even perfect card play lost levels. I tried making mistakes & playing well & it didn't change my win %. I played until I ran out of coins. You must pay real $ for coin packages ($1.99-$14.99) to keep playing which can get expensive. There's no 1-time fee option. Although it's "free" to play, it's eventually impossible. Uninstalling.

It's not great. Only a limited amount of cards, and it will draw cards that have nothing to do with the game board. Rigged game, if you can't read the mind of the game, you won't complete many puzzles on the first try. If you draw a card not what it wants you to, the game is essentially over. Retrying the puzzle costs the same as the first time you try. An extra 5 cards is over half of the cost of trying again. The credits are time based, you could only play two games per regen credit limit.

A prime example of greed! To advance you need coins, which you need to buy for ridiculously high prices! And if you go for small amounts they don't last long - as you advance, features get more expensive. Example- an extra card costs 1000 in the beginning, but after a few lvls it costs over 5000! You can buy a proper AAA game just for price of some silly coins to advance in this game. Game is not designed for enjoyment but to rip you off! Disgusting! AVOID! UNINSTALLED!

The fact that this app has above 4 stars is astounding. In order to play each level you pay coins. Coins are accrued by "harvesting"; once per hour. At any time in the game you can harvest maybe 1.5x the cost to play 1 level. The issue is some levels are completely unbeatable without paying extra coins. Extra coins get you more cards, and even with those you may need to buy more, easily doubling the cost to finish the level, far exceeding the reward. A game that doesnt reward you for playing.

I feel this varient of Solitaire is poor: many games are spent wondering if the deck provided has been set up to have the ability to win. Sometimes, you really cant win. The board is set up in a 'random' fashion, so that no matter what you do, you can't win. I also don't like the idea that you have to spend your way to play using an in game currency. Now, the unwinable decks didn't start until after the first plot was harvestable. No variation in the game either. Just cards spread different ways

Fun game, however too expensinsive to play. Some levels are purposely difficult, so you are required to use your coins to purchase extra cards or items to win. Those items are extremely expensive, and completing a level yields a small amount of coins, making your profit minimal. The game is fun when you earn enough coins. However, it takes several hours to earn enough coins to play multiple rounds in a row. It's just way too expensive. I will be deleting soon.

I really liked this game - til recently! I had alot of coins and could play whenever I wanted. Then suddenly the levels have become so hard AND they cost so many coins to play, that I now have none and am stuck playing same board for hours at times. It's like after Level 2k it becomes too costly. Also, what happened to the option to watch an ad to lower the cost of a level or to get an extra prize after completing the crop? You've taken the fun out of the game and now it's stressful & a hassle!

Started playing this game as a reward for another. Started off great. Had fun. Until after fourth field, then it gets dumb. Unlike candy crush or other games, there are levels where there is absolutely nothing to do but lose. Options just aren't there. No choices. Cards are cards, and can't change Have to wait hours to accumulate coins to play again, for the same thing. Devs are actively making me not play their game by not being able to, less I spend money every few levels. Just not worth it.

Easy to get coins, fun solitaire game. Kinda challenging at times but very worth sticking it out. For the 1st week I could only play a few rounds, expecially if I lost. But after a week of just saving my coins I can play all the time. Edited... I wish the hands didn't cost so much. I bought coins quite a few times and packages but the prices per had are so high the money runs out quickly. Forget about buying a wild if you have 1 card left.. it's crazy high.
