This game is super frustrating because it's actually a lot of fun to play for a game that just advertises itself as Solitaire, but I can't actually play it because the in-game economy makes absolutely no sense. Unless you win every single level on the very first try, you're going to end up with a net loss in coins, and when you win, you get maybe 20% more coins than what you put in just to play the level, which means that only every 5 levels you complete first try, in a row, will you actually get enough coins to play an extra level. It doesn't matter how many crops you plant because as you progress, everything you pay for scales up in price as well (level entry fee and bonuses), so in the end the net difference between what you earn and what you spend stays the same (it might actually get worse since each crop only gives you an additional 50 coins per HOUR, but the cost to play increases by like 500 coins every field; I'm only at around level 80 so I can't say for sure). Playing the bonus levels that increase your crop yield is also pointless because you have to play through 15 expensive levels that have extra challenges, and in the end all you get is 10 extra coins, again, per hour. When it costs 2000 coins just to play one level, 10 coins is completely useless. As mentioned, the only way you really get coins is from a harvest, where you essentially earn about 125% of what it costs just to play a level, give or take depending on how far you are. Other than that, the only way to get any significant amount of coins is to pay real money for it. I bought the $2.99 first time bonus, and was happy to do it because gameplay wise this is a really fun game, which gave me 45,000 coins, but I blew through it in a day, because if you lose a level even once or try to use any of the abilities, you're basically screwed. Even the options to harass your friends with game invites over various social media platforms don't give you any significant amount of coins. It's a real shame. I could sit and play this game for hours but I'm limited to 2-3 levels at a time tops assuming I've opened the app every single hour right at the hour to harvest my mediocre amount of coins. You need to fix this economy. Follow the Candy Crush model if you have to: harvest every 20 minutes at most, and I shouldn't have to open the app every single time to do it (cap auto harvests at 5). There should be other ways to earn coins too. One positive of your game is you have never made me watch an ad, but I'd rather have the option to watch an ad and earn at least one level's worth of coins so I can actually play your game. Add a daily bonus wheel or something too. Or ignore these suggestions and just fix your economy. Level entry fee shouldn't scale as I build my farm. Level 1 should cost the same to play as level 80, and same with the in game bonuses (wild card, +5 cards, etc). Also, the extra levels that "increase the yield", they should at least double my yield, not just add 10. I don't write many reviews but I really like playing your game, and I really want you to fix it so I can continue to do so. It's not worth spending real money on coins when they don't get you anywhere.

Used to be a fun game until they took all (discounts) away. Basically the only opportunities to make credits are when they used to offer 20% off if you watched an ad. Overpriced b.s.! I'm a great solitaire player, but stuck on a level because it gets so ridiculously overpriced. Decent game, but it feels rigged sometimes. Been playing this for years and it used to be fun. In the beginning fun. Like a challenge but constantly needing to pay money to keep going. I just like to play to relax and not get frustrated by attempts to buy something to finish game. I thought the different game styles were a great idea. It made it more interesting. Uninstaller today.

The game sets you up to fail levels that shouldn't be hard at all. Wild cards cost too much when you literally need them to win levels sometimes. The harvest doesn't even make half of what you need to play 2 levels. I want to enjoy this game but it's just set up to waste coins .

Games terrible. I'm sure this review won't stay up, the game feels like it's intentionally rigged to force you to spend money. Now I remember why I quit this game... it's become nothing but non-stop pop-up ads in-game to get you to buy stuff. It takes 15 minutes every time you open the game to even get to play one level. the games coding is set to fail you and crashes you violently money wise so you will be motivated to frustratedly purchase. really not fair to players and they don't give the game at a regular setting a chance and allow the enjoyment of the game to influence purchasing. instead they wait till you get to a high level get attached and every bit you have saved is taken .. it is ridiculous, lots of credible games maintain without this format they should take note it is stressful solitaire 😞

Rigged for you to purchase coins to play. Almost all levels require you to purchase more cards to finish it, has nothing to do with strategy. The graphics are pleasing to the eye and i like the levels styles, but there is no "win guarantee" with the rng, so you can end up with a level where the first 6 cards drawn are unusable. you can also easily end up with just one card left on the board for multiple tries. I've spent years playing this game. I refuse to buy credits because I don't want to become addicted financially, as well as mentally, so I get frustrated when I run out quickly. I wrote customer service with an issue I was having. Emma was so helpful and was so quick in resolving the issue. Friendliness goes a long way. I still love the game but knowing that support will be there if you encounter a rare issue or one they have heard a thousand times makes the game better.

Fun with great variation. It does want you to spend money, but you can go 100% free. A great big huge rip off. Easy to program a game to give you the losing hand until you decide to use your tokens to get extra cards that just happen to be the one you need. Just so convenient. Edit 2: Two annoying things about the game: the excessive animations, and how slow they are, between rounds.
